title: Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi

thread.title: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren’t Wicked • Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi - Episode 12 discussion - FINAL

opinions.point: Several commenters found the finale sweet, sincere, cozy, heartwarming, and consistently smile-inducing.
The supportive, wholesome family dynamic and kind characterization were widely appreciated.
Viewers enjoyed the humor and felt the recurring gags remained effective rather than becoming stale.
One commenter enjoyed the series but wished a younger supporting character had received more screen time.
A commenter who began with no expectations still found the anime fun.
